image_query: Mahabodhi Temple Bodh Gaya Bodhi tree photograph
tweets: At Bodh Gaya, the Mahābodhi Temple rises in brick over the very spot where Siddhārtha Gautama found enlightenment, c. 528 BCE. Beside it grows a descendant of that Bodhi tree, a cutting sent to Sri Lanka by Aśoka's daughter Saṅghamittā, returned home generations later.
